name: Boeing-Stearman Model 75 Kaydet
summary: WWII primary trainer biplane built in thousands; many survive as sport, airshow and wing-walking aircraft.

wings: Biplane: staggered upper and lower wings joined by N-struts and flying wires
engines: Uncowled round radial engine with bare cylinders
fuselage: Fixed tailwheel gear with tall main legs

tellTales: Biplane with two open tandem cockpits
Radial engine with bare cylinders and no cowling
Fixed tailwheel gear with tall main legs

confusedWith.howToTell: The Texan is a monoplane with an enclosed canopy and retractable gear; the Stearman is an open-cockpit biplane.
The Cub is a high-wing cabin monoplane; the Stearman has two wings and open cockpits.

usCount.source: FAA Aircraft Registry make/model query (registered aircraft): A75N1/PT-17, B75N1, E75 and N2S model codes
